subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Vivacious and enthusiastic
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Vivacious"** means lively and animated, full of life and energy. (जीवंत और उत्साही)

 
 
• **Example: **Her **vivacious** personality made her the life of the party.
 
 
 
• **"Effervescent"** refers to someone who is lively, enthusiastic, and full of energy. (उत्साही और जीवंत)
 
 
• **Example: **Her **effervescent** spirit was contagious, spreading joy to everyone around her.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Effervescent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Introverted** (अंतर्मुखी): A person who is shy, reserved, and tends to focus on internal thoughts and feelings.

 
 
• **Example:** As an** introverted **individual, he prefers spending time alone or with a small group of close friends.
 
 
 
• **Rowdy** (उपद्रवी): Noisy and disorderly, often causing trouble.
 
 
• **Example:** The **rowdy **crowd at the concert made it difficult to enjoy the music.
 
 
 
• **Brazen** (निर्लज्ज): Bold and without shame.
 
 
• **Example:** His **brazen** disregard for the rules shocked everyone in the room.
